name: Bluetooth Speaker
description: Guidelines for traveling with bluetooth speaker in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Bluetooth speakers are allowed in carry-on bags. If they contain a built-in lithium-ion battery, they must travel in the cabin.

checkedBag.reason: Speakers with rechargeable lithium-ion batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds to prevent fire risks.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring bluetooth speaker on a plane?

travelTips: Bluetooth speakers are allowed in carry-on bags. If they contain a built-in lithium-ion battery, they must travel in the cabin.

faq.question: Is bluetooth speaker allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Bluetooth Speaker is allowed in carry-on luggage. Bluetooth speakers are allowed in carry-on bags. If they contain a built-in lithium-ion battery, they must travel in the cabin.

faq.question: Can you pack bluetooth speaker in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Bluetooth Speaker is not allowed in checked bags. Speakers with rechargeable lithium-ion batteries are prohibited in checked baggage holds to prevent fire risks.
